Metadata.title: Maskinflyt
Metadata.description: Jobs, drivers and invoices for truck, crane and machine contractors.

Home.title: From phone call to invoice the same day
Home.lead: Maskinflyt replaces phone, text messages and Excel for truck, crane and machine contractors: the job, the driver, the hours worked and the invoice in one place.

receive.title: Plan
receive.body: Enter the job and assign a truck or machine and a driver in the calendar.

check.title: Work
check.body: The driver taps On the way, Arrived and Finished. The hours are recorded from those taps.

approve.title: Invoice
approve.body: An invoice draft is made from the approved hours. A person checks it before anything is sent.

Home.notice: This is an early version. Registration and sign-in work; jobs, the driver app and invoices come in later stages.
